target.title: fix(ci): repair LOC and dead-code ratchets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The TypeScript LOC and unused-export ratchets had both drifted on `main` after concurrent PRs passed against older bases. Exact-main validation then blocked unrelated changes: the LOC baseline could not safely reconcile race-created growth, while the dead-code baseline retained exports that were internal or test-only and acquired new suppressions.

## Why This Change Was Made

LOC baseline reconciliation now reads physical LOC from both the comparison ref and the current tree. A baseline repair may catch up only to the lower count, so existing base drift is recoverable while branch-local growth, shrink headroom, missing files, and inflated baseline values still fail closed.

The dead-code repair removes 14 suppressions rather than adding more. Internal agent, gateway, and sidebar parameter types are no longer exported; OpenAI transport test helpers remain reachable only through the existing `testing` facade; redundant facade and sanitizer exports are removed.

Both generated baselines were refreshed against comparison base `6dfa4c27a3ad6e8cb60b6263c4aa665a93654a1d`.

## User Impact

Unrelated changes can pass both ratchets again. New TypeScript growth and new unused exports remain blocked, while merge-order drift has a bounded repair path.

## Evidence

- `corepack pnpm test:serial test/scripts/check-ts-max-loc.test.ts src/agents/cli-output.test.ts src/agents/openai-tool-projection.live.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts src/agents/schema-normalization-runtime-contract.test.ts` - 415 tests passed
- `corepack pnpm test:serial ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts` - 38 tests passed
- `node scripts/check-deadcode-exports.mjs` - matched 5,512 entries; branch diff removes 14 baseline rows and adds none
- `node --import tsx scripts/check-ts-max-loc.ts --max 500 --base-ref origin/main` - passed
- `corepack pnpm check:changed -- <14 changed paths>` - passed across core, core tests, UI, scripts, test-root, and tooling lanes
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcs3pw7xja6wb0d616ev67f`, Actions run `29222269598`
- Fresh `gpt-5.6-sol` medium branch autoreview - no findings, 0.88 confidence
